newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air NZ won't expand fleet this year, targets costs.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ won't expand fleet this year, targets costs.

text.p: Air New Zealand Ltd said on Monday it planned no expansion of fleet capacity in the next 12 months.
The company also said it had started a rigorous cost reduction programme.

"Over the last five years, Air NZ has undertaken substantial expansion of its international route network and aircraft fleet. There will be no expansion of fleet capacity during the next 12 months, the priority being to consolidate the existing operations through the achievement of higher load factors and the maximum yield retention," the company said.
Air NZ earlier reported a fall in annual net profit to NZ$225.2 million from $260.2 million a year earlier.
It said the aim of the cost reduction programme was to align fixed costs to the more competitive conditions now prevailing.
"The targeted cost reductions total around $100 million, most of which will not come to account until the second half of the year." -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
